prompt:
I first asked Opus 5.5 to figure out how the pdoom video was made, then I asked it to read all our docs, and then make a song appropriate for what our product does.

I took the prompt, gave it to @suno  to make the music. Downloaded the mp3, gave it back to Opus, and asked it to use @runwayml to make the video, and use a kpop style... boom.
